summary: Full E2E test of the YOURFM Feed.fm pivot (Spotify removed). 9/9 pytest backend tests passed and the full UI flow (landing -> stations -> create -> play -> skip -> back -> reopen) works end-to-end against the live deployment. Feed.fm streamed real licensed tracks (Eddie Roberts' West Coast Sounds), all /api/feedfm/* calls returned 200, no geofence rejection.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1158 lines and mixes Spotify/Feed.fm/SeatGeek/Weather/Bumper concerns - consider splitting into routers (stations.py, feedfm.py, bumpers.py, spotify_legacy.py) for maintainability.

Spotify routes (/api/spotify/*) are still mounted even though the user flow is fully Feed.fm; if Spotify is officially dropped, the spotipy import, SpotifyOAuth helpers, /spotify/* routes, and db.spotify_tokens collection should be removed to reduce attack surface and dead code.

StationCreate model exposes feedfm_station_id/feedfm_station_name as Optional, but the new product flow REQUIRES them; consider server-side validation that one of feedfm_station_id is present for new stations.
Player.jsx playBumper() sets b.onended/onerror to the same resolve but doesn't clear them on unmount; minor leak risk if user navigates mid-bumper.
feedfm_request opens a fresh aiohttp.ClientSession per request - acceptable but a module-level session would reduce TLS handshake overhead under load.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing, create, play, skip, navigation all green)

test_credentials: None required (no auth in the new Feed.fm flow). Feed.fm demo creds + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + ELEVEN_API_KEY are server-side.
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up one test station 'AutoTest Station' via the UI flow, then deleted via DELETE /api/stations/<id>. DB is back to 0 user stations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_feedfm_radio.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_feedfm_radio.py -v`. The TestFeedFm class is order-sensitive (uses pytest module attributes to share client_id/stations). Feed.fm demo placement returns 'Station One' (id 33714093) and 'Station Two'. Real cloudfront mp3 URLs come back, so no geofence problem from this pod. Bumper generation (Gemini + ElevenLabs) works end-to-end (~3s) and returns data:audio/mpeg;base64 audio_url. Spotify code is still present in server.py but the UI never invokes it.
